final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Pod sheet outlier: emailservice-75d7c8757-7pmzv is 0/1 CrashLoopBackOff with RESTARTS=4 while all other 10 boutique pods are 1/1 Running with 0 restarts. Pod detail shows Last State: Terminated, Reason: Error, Exit Code: 137, and its Events give the mechanism verbatim: 'Warning Unhealthy  Liveness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.1.163:8080" within 1s: context deadline exceeded' followed by 'Normal Killing  Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' and 'Warning BackOff  Back-off restarting failed container server'. Namepace events repeat the same chain for this pod (Unhealthy -> Killing -> BackOff). GetAppYAML(emailservice) confirms the breakpoint: livenessProbe has initialDelaySeconds=1, periodSeconds=1, timeoutSeconds=1, failureThreshold=1, i.e. first probe 1s after start, 1s timeout, kill on first failure. GetRecentLogs shows the app is healthy but needs about 2s to become ready: process start at 15:49:04.91, then 'listening on port: 8080' at 15:49:06.91, while the terminated container only lived 7s (15:48:08 -> 15:48:15). Port and protocol are correct (container PORT=8080 and listening on 8080; probe targets grpc port 8080), and Reason is Error rather than OOMKilled, so the restart is a liveness-timing kill, not a port/protocol error or OOM. Probe timing shorter than the real startup window is therefore the root cause of the abnormal restarts.
